title: G27 · 拒绝
body: I left the seven proven non-matrix functions unchanged and replaced only the eligible integer matrix path with a conservative exact-radix kernel that computes three dot products per fused update, falling back to two columns when necessary and to the proven champion for every non-exact or unsafe domain. Dynamic radix sizing, conservative bounds below 2^53, quotient-based decoding, explicit zero normalization, representation-specialized loads, eight-way unrolling, and complete odd-tail handling preserve exact outputs and argument immutability; the projected reduction from roughly n³ to n³/3 fused updates should provide the matrix-only margin needed for aggregate acceptance.
